Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensure a common operating experience for their users.
As an engineering manager you need to bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of your team. You will also need to represent the team in direct partner engagement. You'll be responsible for the stability and functionality that our cloud users have come to expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers.
As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. As a lead for strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in software development is a must, so that you're able to challenge and grow your team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team is building with. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.
The role entails

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. From great products to long-lasting companies, we believe that nothing great is made alone—come make with us!

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive who will play a critical role driving sales and maximizing revenue with our Enterprise customers. You will be responsible for targeting, building and nurturing positive relationships with key executive level decision-makers, understanding complex business needs, and delivering innovative solutions across our product suite. This is an opportunity to accelerate your career, learn from leading sellers in the industry, and build an incredible network of cross-functional partners at Figma.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Create and manage a pipeline of Enterprise accounts to consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
  • Apply effective discovery and value-selling techniques to build and strengthen relationships with key decision-makers in both new and existing customers (5000+ FTEs).
  • Align with executives on business challenges and gain sponsorship for enterprise-wide deployments for a suite of products, identifying where Figma’s roadmap and innovations fit in the long term.
  • Conduct thorough analysis to create strategic account plans that outline company priorities and initiatives, multi-threading at an executive level to build on expansion opportunities.
  • Manage a book of business by tiering accounts and initiating techniques to save contractions.
  • Co-create with cross-functional partners to expertly position Figma, drive deals forward, and ensure customer success.
  • Leverage opportunities to advance executive level relationships through in-person meetings and networking opportunities.

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • Experience closing sales, over multiple years, for a software or SaaS business with an Enterprise book of customers (5000+ FTEs), selling to executives.

  • A sales methodology and process that creates value for customers.
  • This role will focus on supporting customers using our product in Latin America. Written and spoken fluency in Portuguese and English is required.

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience selling solutions to technical audiences at a strategic level (i.e. Engineering, Product, Design teams).
  • Demonstrated ability to succeed in a changing environment.

If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product, and our community to flourish. Join to apply for the Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management) role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management) to build high-performing Go and Python services and secure identity and access management solutions that will be used across all company products. From Ubuntu One SSO to Juju, LXD and MAAS your team will define the way Canonical users, clients and community members access their favorite open source applications.
This is an opportunity for a software engineering manager with a passion for distributed systems operations to help us transform the future of identity management at Canonical. Experience in the identity and access management (IAM) field is desirable but not required. You will work with upstream open source projects, alongside internal teams to deliver high quality software that can be deployed on bare metal, public cloud and Kubernetes.
As the identity team engineering manager you will bring significant software development experience, Kubernetes knowledge and a keen eye for software design, performance and security. You will be responsible for working with product management to define the technical vision for the products, managing the team backlog, reviewing code and coaching younger team members.
You will also be involved in all the aspects of the software development process: you will design software, write high-quality code and tests, provide insightful code reviews, write documentation and help to troubleshoot issues.
In addition to the engineering behind the project itself, you'll have the chance to work with industry-leading teams inside Canonical, ensuring your work is backed by rock-solid data stores, and highly observable using our Kubernetes-based Observability stack. You'll work with broader open source communities, participating in "hackfest" events, webinars and conferences.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or AMER regions.
What we are looking for in you

  • Proven experience hiring and leading a high performance software engineering team
  • Experience with Go and Python software development
  • Ability to design and implement complex, distributed system
  • Experience working with container technology and Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of software/infrastructure security and performance
  • Experience designing and/or operating large scale distributed systems
  • Knowledge of identity and access management technologies and standards is desirable but not essential
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Who will you be working with?

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

How will you make a difference?

The Lead Engineer/Technologist – Train Control will work with customers, various suppliers, engineering teams, and industry agencies to identify and capture requirements to execute controls design and implementation. This group is made up of over a dozen subsystem functions and components and is the overall system integrator for third-party/customer-supplied equipment and a driver of overall infrastructure for the Locomotive Control System.

What do we want to know about you?

  1. Bachelor of Science in Engineering or related field;
  2. Proven experience in an engineering position;
  3. Experience with controls/software design, diagnostics, and test;
  4. Ability and willingness to work "hands-on" in test labs and on locomotives with high HP (1000 KVA), medium voltage (2 KV) and high current (10 KA) systems;
  5. Strong English technical writing and communication skills;
  6. Experience with MATLAB Simulink or other Modeling tools preferred.

What will your typical day look like?

The Lead Engineer/Technologist – Train Control will play a pivotal role in the development of the Locomotive Control System by executing a variety of projects from follow-on orders (Requisitions) through new product developments ensuring proper definition of requirements and interfaces for Locomotive Control Systems. The engineer will design, integrate, and validate Train Control subsystem functions for locomotives suitable for application in both English and non-English speaking environments by using sound engineering principles and adhering to business standards, practices, and procedures. In addition, the engineer will lead/support investigations for root-cause identification and resolution of reliability issues.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Sobre a Vaga:

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Fisioterapeutas Visitadores , apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

Diagnóstico que Buscamos:

  • Formação em Fisioterapia e registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fisioterapia (CREFITO).
  • Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial.
  • Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para o estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós:

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um Fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar cuidados de alta qualidade, respeito, compaixão e empatia aos idosos, promovendo o seu bem-estar físico, emocional e psicológico, garantindo a segurança e a integridade do paciente, prevenindo e tratando eventuais problemas de saúde relacionados a mobilidade humana. O Fisioterapeuta com ênfase no tratamento de idosos desempenha um papel crucial na educação do paciente, praticando cuidados adequados e promovendo orientações e acompanhamento para o envelhecimento saudável e digno.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  1. Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, tornando a assistência personalizada.
  2. Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidar, mantendo-os atualizados.
  3. Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas.
  4. Realizar o Cuidado Integral ao Paciente, cuidando com Empatia e Carinho, estabelecendo vínculos e considerando as suas necessidades biopsicossociais.
  5. Garantir a continuidade da Assistência em Fisioterapia, por meio da execução do Plano de Cuidado estabelecido.
  6. Distribuir adequadamente a agenda de consultas, cumprindo a carga horária e número de atendimentos, conforme o contrato estabelecido.

CONTEXTO / DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

No âmbito da parceria com a Enel Distribuição São Paulo e Ceará, a AVSI Brasil atuará a partir de 2025 na execução e formatação sistemática do PROGRAMA ECOENEL - Troca de resíduos por bônus na conta de energia. Esta iniciativa considera a educação ambiental, por meio da reciclagem, como elemento fundamentador da construção de uma sociedade com maior responsabilidade social e ambiental.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA

O/a Mobilizador/a Social será responsável pela realização das atividades do projeto que prevêem contato com público (pessoa física ou jurídica), tendo como objetivo a divulgação do projeto e a realização de atividades que promovam a consciência ambiental, conceitos de reciclagem e impacto no meio ambiente.

PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES

  1. Realizar atividades de mobilização do público nas áreas ao redor dos pontos de coleta, a fim de aumentar a adesão de pessoas físicas;
  2. Realizar atividades de mobilização junto aos parceiros do projeto, com o objetivo de aumentar a eficiência das coletas e divulgar os resultados alcançados;
  3. Realizar palestras educativas em escolas, instituições sociais, parceiros e empresas para divulgar e disseminar os conceitos de reciclagem, preservação do meio ambiente e eficiência energética;
  4. Auxiliar na criação e execução de campanhas promocionais;
  5. Organizar e executar gincanas em escolas e instituições;
  6. Manter atualizados os indicadores do projeto, elaborando relatórios mensais das atividades realizadas;
  7. Sugerir à Supervisão e à Gerência do projeto matérias ou notícias para divulgação nos canais institucionais da organização, apoiando seus devidos registros;
  8. Prestar suporte às atividades previstas pela área de comunicação da ENEL nos Ecopontos, sempre que solicitado;
  9. Realizar suporte ao serviço de Supervisão, principalmente nos postos de coleta, através de visitas de inspeção, conforme orientação da Gerência;
  10. Manter organizado e atualizado o arquivo de documentos do Projeto;
  11. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização;
  12. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internos;

title: Tax Coordinator
description:
Join to apply for the Tax Coordinator role at Unilever

About Unilever

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

Job Purpose

Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. If you love fast-paced environments, are passionate about helping others, and like the sounds of acting as an orchestrator where your impacts will be felt throughout multiple countries then this role is just for you!

Business Context: Direct Taxes are the taxes levied on profit, from here the employee will:

  • manage direct taxes in a collaborative environment;
  • interact with other areas of the group (finance, marketing, sales);
  • be introduced to company´s businesses;
  • work for and with the decision makers.

Main Purpose

Support the company on the management and reporting of direct taxes, ensuring compliance, optimizing cash flow, and being aware of the company´s profitability. These efforts contribute to the Group's Sustainable Living Plan Goal.

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be

  • Calculate and report direct taxes (IRPJ and CSLL), including current, deferred, and contingent taxes, as well as taxes on cross-border transactions (royalties, cost sharing, dividends, interest, CIDE, IOF, etc);
  • Understand Gaap Differences such as Brazil Gaap, IFRS, USGAAP;
  • Perform Transfer Pricing calculations;
  • Obtain and maintain tax incentives (e.g., Lucro da Exploração, Inovação Tecnológica, Lei Rouanet);
  • Review and supervise calculations, payments, and tax returns;
  • Manage tax contingencies and exposures;
  • Analyze and interpret direct tax law;
  • Engage in direct tax planning (M&A, new business models, etc);
  • Forecast direct tax outcomes;
  • Calculate Effective Tax Rate (ETR);
  • Prepare and present tax reports locally and globally;
  • Partner with other areas for consultancy;
  • Participate in tax audits (internal and external);
  • Handle tax inspections by authorities.

Experiences & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree completed;
  • Experience in Corporate Income Taxes (IRPJ and CSLL) and remittances;
  • Proficiency in English (writing, reading, speaking);
  • Knowledge of Tax and Accounting principles.

Desirable Skills

  • Power BI;
  • Automation and tax transformation;
  • Data analysis skills.

Skills

  • Time management;
  • Decision making;
  • Growth mindset;
  • Collaboration and teamwork;
  • Positivity;
  • Creative thinking;
  • Conflict resolution;
  • Motivation;
  • Openness to innovation.

Leadership

  • Deliver results with enthusiasm;
  • Lead by example in results and resilience;
  • Seek continuous improvement and collaborate;
  • Own your wellbeing and work standards;
  • Be humble, data-driven, and proactive in identifying issues and opportunities.

Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life. We are committed to equity, inclusion, and diversity to drive our results and create a better future. We want everyone to bring their ‘Whole Self’ to work. If you need support or accommodations, please inform us during your application process.

Sobre o cargo

Você desempenhará um papel vital na promoção e venda de nossos cursos de idiomas no exterior. Você será responsável por estabelecer e manter relacionamentos com clientes potenciais, orientando-os no processo de vendas e garantindo sua satisfação com nossos serviços. Seu objetivo principal será atingir as metas de vendas e, ao mesmo tempo, oferecer um atendimento ao cliente excepcional. O Consultor de Vendas no Escritório de Belo Horizonte é o principal responsável pela venda de nossos programas e pela conexão com nossos clientes por telefone, pessoalmente, online e pelas redes sociais.

Responsabilidades:

  • Construção de Relacionamento: Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos sólidos com os clientes, entendendo suas necessidades e fornecendo soluções adequadas com base em nossas ofertas de cursos de idiomas.
  • Venda Consultiva: Utilize sua experiência em vendas para interagir com clientes em potencial, oferecendo conselhos e recomendações personalizadas para atender às suas metas e objetivos de aprendizagem de idiomas.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Garantir um alto nível de satisfação do cliente respondendo a dúvidas, resolvendo problemas e fornecendo suporte conforme necessário.
  • Colaboração Internacional: Colaborar com colegas de vários países e origens culturais para trocar melhores práticas e oferecer uma experiência global consistente aos nossos clientes.
  • Alcance de metas: atingir ou superar metas de vendas e indicadores-chave de desempenho, buscando consistentemente o sucesso em um ambiente de ritmo acelerado. KPIs relacionados a ligações, visitas de potenciais clientes aos nossos escritórios, reuniões online eficazes e muito mais.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Relações Internacionais, Administração, Turismo e áreas afins.
  • Experiência em Vendas: é desejável experiência anterior em alguma função de vendas, de preferência em um ambiente de ritmo acelerado. Experiência na indústria de educação/viagens ou venda de produtos/serviços intangíveis será uma vantagem.
  • Inglês falado e escrito: mínimo nível intermediário.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologia: proficiente no uso de ferramentas de vendas e CRM para gerenciar leads , acompanhar o progresso e estar ciente de seus KPIs e resultados.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Iniciativa e ambição de Vendas;
  • Possuir uma forte motivação para atingir metas de vendas e superar as expectativas dos clientes;
  • Orientado para resultados;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Experiência Internacional: Ter vivido, trabalhado ou estudado no exterior é estrategicamente recomendável para se relacionar com as experiências e necessidades de potenciais clientes interessados em cursos de idiomas no exterior;
  • Orientado para a satisfação ao cliente: Paixão por oferecer um excelente atendimento ao cliente e construir relacionamentos de longo prazo;
  • Adaptabilidade, resiliência: Prosperar em um ambiente dinâmico e de ritmo acelerado, demonstrando capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e superar desafios;
  • Trabalho em equipe: Colabore eficazmente com colegas de diversas origens, demonstrando sensibilidade cultural e abertura a diferentes perspectivas;

O sucesso nesta função é definido pelo alcance das metas de vendas semanais e mensais. Queremos receber novos talentos em nossa equipe e incentivá-los a se divertirem enquanto ajudamos outras pessoas a planejar o melhor momento de suas vidas estudando idiomas com a EF no exterior.

Desde 1965, ajudamos milhões de pessoas a conhecer novos lugares, vivenciar novas culturas e aprender coisas novas sobre o mundo e sobre si mesmas. Nossos programas educacionais culturalmente imersivos – focados em idiomas, viagens, intercâmbio cultural e acadêmicos – transformam sonhos em oportunidades internacionais.

Ao ingressar na EF, você se junta a uma comunidade multicultural e diversificada que trabalha em mais de 600 escolas e escritórios em 50 países, todos com a missão compartilhada de abrir o mundo através da educação. Seja você quem for, seja qual for sua paixão, nós lhe damos as boas-vindas e queremos que você leve isso para o trabalho todos os dias. A EF tem orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais e estamos comprometidos com a inclusão e o pertencimento de raça, etnia, gênero, idade, religião, casta, status parental, identidade, experiência e tudo o mais que o torna único.

  1. Análise e Desenvolvimento: compreender as necessidades dos usuários e traduzi-las em soluções técnicas eficientes dentro do SAP B1.

  6. Suporte Técnico: oferecer suporte para usuários internos, auxiliando na resolução de problemas e otimização do uso do sistema.

  • Sólida experiência técnica em SAP B1 SDK e desenvolvimento de integrações e add-ons.
  • Forte conhecimento em C# ou outra linguagem aplicável para desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST via JSON.
  • Capacidade analítica para compreender as necessidades do negócio e transformá-las em soluções eficazes.
  • Habilidade de organização e documentação, garantindo rastreabilidade e qualidade no desenvolvimento.
  • Boa comunicação, facilitando o alinhamento com stakeholders e equipes internas.

O que é essencial você trazer?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e customização de SAP B1.
  • Domínio do Service Layer e APIs do SAP B1.
  • Experiência com C#, SQL e Web Services (REST, SOAP).
  • Conhecimento sobre módulos do SAP B1 e suas aplicações.

  • Experiência em testes e validações de implementações no SAP B1.

Será um diferencial se você também trouxer conhecimentos em SAP HANA, ferramentas de automação e versionamento de código (Git, Jenkins), certificações SAP B1 ou especializações em ERP, além de vivência no setor de varejo ou mercados autônomos.

Company Description
Do you want to work on the largest healthcare platform in the WORLD ? We are Doctoralia , a Docplanner Group company, present in 13 countries , responsible for serving more than 55 million patients and processing more than 15 million appointments per month! We currently have more than 2 million healthcare professionals in our database, totaling approximately 10 million patient evaluations to date.
Our mission is to “make the healthcare experience more human.” Through a diverse range of services, we are able to serve different audiences: our marketplace, which allows patients to schedule and evaluate appointments and doctors at any time of the day or night; and our SaaS system (Software as a Service) aimed at optimizing office management, patient flow and online bookings. All this through an internet platform and our iOS/Android apps.

The management role focuses on KPI analysis, and creating tactical and operational plans while constantly seeking improvement and efficiency opportunities. It also involves collecting and analyzing feedback from the major stakeholders (Customer Success, Customer Care, Data Quality) to identify trends and areas for enhancement, always aligning local team practices with global standards.

title: Banco de Talentos - Study Abroad Advisor (423779)
description:
PREP ESTUDAR FORA is a community-based program which aims to prepare talented Brazilian students for the application processes of the best universities abroad, at no cost whatsoever to the participants. Every year, we identify students through a rigorous, merit-based selection process to receive free guidance and preparation as they strive towards beginning their undergraduate education outside of Brazil. Participants receive an individual mentor who completed his undergraduate education abroad, virtual group orientation, nine hours of counseling with FUNDAÇÃO ESTUDAR’S professional college counselors and enrollment in an online preparation course comprised of detailed videos and homework assignments related to the application process. In addition, we offer need-based scholarships to help students cover the costs of the process (standardized tests, translations, a test preparation course, application fees, etc).

Student Counseling

  1. Advise a specific cohort of students on the college admission process by creating individualized plans and executing on them in collaboration with the student and student’s mentor.
  2. Continually research and expand a knowledge base with resources to support students in applying for college, including maintaining knowledge of high school curricula, college research, extracurricular and leadership choices, and standardized test planning to make recommendations regarding admissions strategies.
  3. Utilize in-depth knowledge of institutions of higher learning to guide students towards attainable school goals, working with them to create lists of best-fit schools of varied competition to maximize chances of acceptances and financial support.
  4. Guide students through the college essay writing processes, providing continuous feedback and personalized support.
  5. Provide assistance with standardized test planning and study tips (SAT/ACT and DET/TOEFL/IELTS).
  6. Lead student group training sessions and present as an expert speaker on external webinars.
  7. Maintain a high level of communication with your advisees through various channels (e.g. email, WhatsApp, etc.) and 1:1 advisement meetings.

Application Management & Student Support
  1. Oversee and manage projects related to the college admissions process for the entire program, including organizing and tracking student application deadlines and ensuring the quality completion of application requirements such as letters of recommendation, school profiles, and essays.
  2. Develop and implement program-wide support initiatives, such as workshops, presentations, and training sessions on topics such as application essay writing, college research, and financial aid.
  3. Monitor and analyze program data to assess effectiveness and make recommendations for improvement.
  4. Synergize with other areas of Fundação Estudar, to support the program’s students with other opportunities within the organization and to provide insight on study abroad trends.
  5. Maintain a high level of communication with program partners, such as high schools and universities, to ensure seamless collaboration and coordination.

title: Translation Project Coordinator
description:
Language Insight is a fast-growing translation and language services provider. Our experienced teams work on projects covering a wide range of sectors, and are dedicated to delivering high-quality translation, transcription, interpreting and various other language solutions to clients worldwide.

Language Insight is expanding our Project Management team in the Americas and is looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Project Coordinator, who is pursuing to develop their career in the translation industry. The right candidate must be proactive, display a professional attitude, have the willingness to learn, and a desire to put clients first.

The position is remote and candidates will be based in Latin America to support our US team's working hours - 9am to 5:30pm EST (Monday to Friday). Some overtime after 5:30pm might be necessary on busy days/periods. We will be aiming to select the right candidate by the end of the year for a start in January 2025.

What does the role involve?

The Project Coordinator will primarily support our US clients, mainly across the Market Research sector, and will be responsible for handling multiple projects throughout their life cycle. This role will help ensure Language Insight remains one of the market leaders in the translation industry, enabling us to support clients across the world.

As this role will require autonomous working, Language Insight will provide a comprehensive training period of approximately 3-4 months (depending on individual progression) at the start of the contract. This training period will give the Project Coordinator an opportunity to develop their professional skills and equip them with the knowledge and tools needed for the position. During the training period, the candidate will be expected to work UK hours 0900 – 1730, so that they can be trained by our most experienced members of the team.

As part of the Project Coordinator role, you will:

  • Develop an understanding of the Translation and Market Research Industries.
  • Manage the full cycle of language services for our clients (from file prepping and quoting to delivering), ensuring that quality control measures have been adhered to.
  • Develop trusted relationships with clients, colleagues, and linguists.
  • Work closely with the Project Management team to offer support and share ideas on best practices.
  • Support our US clients by providing excellent customer service through responsiveness and a consultative approach.

Além disso, há experiências que só a C&A pode oferecer: ambiente leve, informal e divertido; valores e compromissos inegociáveis para a sociedade; desenvolvimento profissional no varejo; e conexão com uma marca de renome e que entrega resultados consistentes. title: Faça sua Carreira de Engenharia de Processos no Itaú --
description:
Vem construir no Itaú

Como maior banco privado da América Latina, acompanhamos de perto o desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias e enxergamos o processo como uma evolução natural do nosso negócio, que torna possível termos um contato ainda mais próximo com a experiência de nossos clientes para continuarmos aprimorando suas jornadas.

Como é a área de Operações?

Ao longo de nossa história, desempenhamos um papel fundamental na estratégia do Itaú Unibanco . Dentro deste contexto, todos os produtos que oferecemos aos nossos clientes passam a ser produtos tecnológicos, independente da interface que ele escolha – seja ela física, digital ou mista. Vem construir soluções digitais em uma das maiores instituições financeiras da América Latina!

Como é a Carreira de Engenharia de Processos?

A Engenharia de processos no Itaú exerce um papel fundamental na busca constante da melhor jornada para nossos clientes, vem pra repensar o fundamental (ir na causa raiz das coisas), buscar a reestruturação radical dos processos que visam alcançar mudanças disruptivas em indicadores críticos de desempenho, tais como qualidade, custos, riscos e agilidade. A pessoa engenheira de processos pode estar alocada em Squads, em comunidades ou nas áreas do banco atuando sempre em projetos de transformação e melhoria contínua (Build e Run).


Como será o seu dia a dia?

  1. Garantir a aplicabilidade dos métodos para transformação das Jornadas fim a fim dos clientes.
  2. Priorizar as ações quantificando o impacto através de uma Engenharia de Valor, garantindo assertividade nas escolhas que agregam.
  3. Atuar no mapeamento de processos, resolução de problemas, construção e redesenho de jornadas, com foco no cliente, eficiência, qualidade e gestão de riscos.
  4. Desdobrar as dores dos clientes e conectar com elementos de processo.
  5. Realizar o estudo e a construção dos requisitos para os desenvolvimentos de tecnologia dos problemas assegurando o reuso de soluções.
  6. Desenvolver soluções em No/Low-Code para transformação dos processos. Garantir o teste funcional e homologação de requisitos de processos nas soluções desenvolvidas.
  7. Estruturar Gestão e Controle dos processos, aplicando ferramentas de qualidade, planejamento de demanda, intervenções operacionais, process mining, gestão da rotina, entre outras.

*Modelo de trabalho: híbrido de 8x presenciais no mês


Quais são as habilidades e competências necessárias?

Principais habilidades técnicas com experiência prática:

  1. LEAN
  2. Qualidade
  3. PCP (Planejamento e Controle de Produção)
  4. Gestão de Projetos/ Métodos Ágeis
  5. Análise e exploração de Dados
  6. Process Mining
  7. Método de Solução de Problemas

Formação em Engenharia de Produção é um diferencial.

O que esperamos de você:

  1. Habilidade em criticar de forma construtiva e provocativa;
  2. Habilidade em negociação e construção de parcerias;
  3. Capacidade analítica/ lógica;
  4. Habilidade em conectar conhecimento técnico com a estratégia dos projetos;
  5. Organização, disciplina e pró-atividade;
  6. Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe de forma colaborativa;
  7. Capacidade de tomada de decisões com base em processos e dados, foco no cliente e resultados.

A Cultura Ituber

Para nós, a transformação começa quando olhamos para trás: reconhecemos tudo o que construímos juntos até aqui e nos orgulhamos, afinal, são quase 100 anos de história!

O nosso principal pilar é a ética: pra gente, ética é inegociável. Ou seja, nos comprometemos a fazer sempre o certo, sem jeitinhos, sem atalhos.

A partir desse pilar principal, temos os nossos outros direcionadores:

  1. A gente trabalha para o cliente;
  2. A gente não sabe tudo;
  3. A gente é movido por resultado;
  4. A gente quer diversidade e inclusão;
  5. A gente #VaiDeTurma!

Ao se tornar um Ituber você tem:

  1. Vale Transporte;
  2. Vale Refeição (Restaurantes) / Vale Alimentação (Supermercados);
  3. Convênio médico e odontológico;
  4. Seguro de Vida;
  5. PLR – Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Mediante resultados do banco);
  6. Previdência privada;
  7. Descontos exclusivos em nossos produtos financeiros;
  8. Licença maternidade estendida & paternidade;
  9. Auxílio Creche / Babá (para papais e mamães);
  10. Incentivo a estudos;
  11. GymPass ou TotalPass;
  12. Acesso aos Clubes Itaú (Guarapiranga / Itanhaém e São Sebastião);
  13. + Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo.

*Estimulamos candidaturas de pessoas com deficiência em todas as nossas posições, sendo assim, sinta-se à vontade para se candidatar em vagas sinalizadas como exclusivas ou não para pessoas com deficiência. Somos comprometidos com a inclusão e valorizamos a diversidade.

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, with 5+ years in Azure environments

  • Implement DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, role-based access controls (RBAC), and proactive threat mitigation using Azure Defender and Sentinel
  • Continuously monitor Azure cost trends, implementing FinOps strategies to optimize cloud expenses while maintaining performance and security
  • Administer and enhance Azure AD B2C, ensuring secure authentication and identity management
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring data integrity and business continuity
  • Work closely with Engineering and Security teams, documenting best practices, infrastructure changes, and operational procedures
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

3. ATRIBUIÇÕES PRINCIPAIS

  1. Executar os procedimentos privativos e relacionados a práticas avançadas de enfermagem, através das diretrizes do modelo assistencial para garantir as melhores práticas institucionais.

Receber o plantão e proceder a assistência direta aos pacientes, observando, acompanhando, reconhecendo sinais/sintomas e registrando as ações e, ao término do plantão informar e esclarecer a assistência prestada aos pacientes através da passagem de plantão em instrumento estruturado institucional.
  3. Realizar e planejar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE) estabelecendo níveis de responsabilidade na execução das ações planejadas entre equipe de enfermagem, avaliando os resultados e registrando-os durante a internação, através das necessidades de cada paciente.
  4. Coordenar processos que garantam uma assistência segura e de qualidade a todos os pacientes sob sua responsabilidade nas diferentes situações críticas, através das diretrizes institucionais.
  5. Promover e participar da integração da equipe multiprofissional, procurando garantir uma assistência integral ao cliente e familiares.
  6. Apoiar demais setores, conforme direcionamento de liderança, viabilizando o atendimento de todos os pacientes internados no HSC.
  7. Participação ativa em visita multidisciplinar buscando o alinhamento das necessidades assistenciais dos pacientes e familiares sob sua responsabilidade.
  8. Garantir a comunicação ativa junto a equipe multidisciplinar visando facilitar o planejamento e execução das ações pertinentes as boas práticas.
  9. Contribuir com o desenvolvimento do colaborador, através de educação em atividades baseadas em normas, protocolos e procedimentos institucionais.
  10. Realizar o acompanhamento e treinamento de colaboradores recém-admitidos, com exercício de mesma função assistencial.
  11. Garantir as ações de preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos da unidade, preservando o funcionamento adequado conforme políticas institucionais.
  12. Exercer as atividades baseado nos protocolos institucionais na busca da prevenção e controle sistemático de danos a pacientes durante a assistência de saúde.
  13. Participar dos treinamentos e eventos institucionais pertinentes ao cargo.
  14. Multiplicar informações relacionadas a boas práticas assistenciais junto a equipe multidisciplinar de área de atuação.
  15. Realizar notificações de não conformidades e eventos identificados visando manter a qualidade e segurança da assistência prestada.
  16. Executar as práticas de segurança através do cumprimento das normativas da NR-32, medicina ocupacional, SCIH e SEST.

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO: Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO: Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES: Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

title: Sr Brand Manager Scotch Portfolio (Vaga Afirmativa para pessoas pretas e pardas)
description:
Job Description :

WE'RE DIAGEO. The beverage alcohol global industry leader and home to some the most recognizable and popular brands in the world: Johnnie Walker, Smirnoff, Tanqueray and Guinness... and we're only just getting started. But we're more than just our brands. We are committed to becoming the best performing, most trusted and respected consumer products company in the world. Being passionate about our consumers and customers sits both at the heart of our values and how we will deliver our performance ambition in every country where Diageo operates.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR? We seek to attract the best talent people and inspire them to deliver their best work ever. Passionate, engaged and talented individuals of all kinds who are hungry to do great work—and have a lot of fun while doing it. It's all about finding people who can inspire a team, drive brand and category growth, and make our brands famous.

Sr. Brand Manager – Scotch Portfolio (Black&White, Buchanans, Old Parr, White Horse)

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven marketing leader to manage Scotch Portfolio brands with a proven track record in strategic thinking, consumer insights, brand development, and effective execution. This role requires someone who can navigate the full marketing process—from concept to execution — helping us define the future of White Horse, within portfolio, communication and cultural strategy development and execution while demonstrating strong business acumen, leadership, and a deep understanding of the competitive landscape.

The ideal candidate will be action-oriented, adaptable, and skilled at managing multiple workstreams (ATL/BTL plans) simultaneously, ensuring attention to detail and excellence in every consumer interaction. We are looking for a balance of brand activation expertise, business insight, and leadership abilities to collaborate effectively with internal and external partners across a fast-paced and competitive category. Impact, boldness, and creativity are essential to success.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Lead Scotch Portfolio strategy, including the development of a 5-year vision and annual business plans.

  2. White Horse brand management – lead development and implementation of White Horse brand communication, events and cultural strategy based on consumer insights, cultural trends, and market dynamics.

  3. Manage the annual planning process, ensuring alignment with growth drivers, market share, financial goals, and the delivery of brand and communication plans.

  4. Collaborate with creative agencies, global and local brand teams, Customer Marketing, Market Insights, and Innovation to design and execute comprehensive brand plans across Media, Culture, Activation, On-Trade, Off-Trade, and Events.

  5. Lead and mentor a brand team, fostering talent development and encouraging a collaborative, high-performance culture.

To succeed in this role, the candidate must have:

  1. A minimum of 8 years of proven experience in brand management.

  2. Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to thrive in dynamic and complex environments.

  3. Strong execution capabilities with the ability to prioritize and manage competing demands effectively.

  4. Strong drive, delivery and determination. Proven ability to think strategically and drive long-term business growth across a complex and broad portfolio.

  5. High levels of accountability and autonomy.

  6. Creative flair and consumer back obsession, reflected in outstanding creative work.

  7. Having the ability to fast adapt to changes and make all actions tangible measuring impact and results with clear learnings.

  8. Written and verbal communication skills in English.

Flexible Working Statement:

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

Diversity statement:

Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. And creating an inclusive culture, where everyone feels valued and that they can belong, is a crucial part of this. We embrace diversity in the broadest possible sense. This means that you’ll be welcomed and celebrated for who you are just by being you. You’ll be part of and help build and champion an inclusive culture that celebrates people of different gender, ethnicity, ability, age, sexual orientation, social class, educational backgrounds, experiences, mindsets, and more.

Our ambition is to create the best performing, most trusted and respected consumer products companies in the world. Join us and help transform our business as we take our brands to new heights and build new ones as part of shaping the next generation of celebrations for consumers around the world.

description:

Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hours! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional skills that would be nice to have
The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions, data pipelines, or orchestrating workflows for the cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management to work on authorization and access management across Canonical's suite of enterprise products and web services, using Go (Golang) and Python.
As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our canonical.com and ubuntu.com websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products.
Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and optionally Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You are a software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform
In addition:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

* Posição disponível para trabalhar nos escritórios de Belo Horizonte/MG ou São Paulo/SP.

Missão

A missão do nossoConsultor de Onboarding é orientar, diagnosticar, ativar, fidelizar e encantar produtores de conteúdo garantindo a compreensão das funcionalidades da Hotmart, além da aplicação de estratégias para otimizar seu desempenho na plataforma. O consultor tem como objetivo apresentar a Hotmart para o cliente e impulsionar a migração total para a plataforma, contribuindo com o crescimento do produtor, na evolução de seus negócios e fortalecimento da marca da empresa para o mercado. Esse profissional tem que ser apaixonado por desafios e ter um domínio de comunicação muito bem estruturado.

Aqui, suas responsabilidades serão :

  • Conduzir sessões de treinamento individuais para clientes novos e existentes.
  • Orientar os clientes na configuração e utilização das ferramentas da Hotmart para maximizar o desempenho de suas vendas.
  • Suportar a migração de plataforma.
  • Acompanhar de perto a ativação e início de vendas dos clientes, fornecendo suporte contínuo e orientação.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria no processo de onboarding e sugerir soluções para otimização.
  • Colaborar com outras equipes, como Suporte ao Cliente e Desenvolvimento de Produto, para resolver problemas e melhorar a experiência do cliente.

Qualificações que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia em atendimento ao cliente, preferencialmente em ambiente digital.
  • Conhecimento básico de marketing digital e vendas online é uma vantagem.

Benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem custo para o colaborador e com coparticipação para cônjuge e dependentes;
  • Vale refeição/alimentação (Flash - bandeira Visa);

  • Previdência privada;

  • Wellhub;
  • Auxílio creche para filhos de até cinco anos;
  • Budget de educação: valor destinado aos investimentos relacionados à sua educação, de forma a contribuir para desenvolver e potencializar suas competências;
  • Incentivo ao aprendizado de idiomas por meio de plataforma online;
  • Baby On Board: benefício oferecido para as pessoas que estão se preparando para a maternidade e paternidade;
  • Licença maternidade estendida (180 dias);
  • Licença Paternidade estendida (30 dias);
  • Conexa Saúde: acesso online gratuito a profissionais da área da saúde - Nutricionista e Psicólogo;
  • Participação anual nos lucros e resultados da companhia (PLR);
  • Hotmart Recharge: bônus de 30% do salário bruto mensal, pago após cumprir o período aquisitivo de férias de 30 dias.

Fazer parte do nosso time, é acordar todos os dias com a certeza de que o mundo é pequeno para o tamanho do impacto que podemos gerar. Vem pra Hotmart e apaixone-se por transformar: você, sua carreira, o mundo!

title: Gerente de Negócios Agro | Cascavel
description:
Job description

Você está na página da maior e mais completa cooperativa de crédito independente do país, e a maior com atuação preferencial na área da saúde.

Somos mais de 500 colaboradores que juntos trabalham pelo propósito de melhorar a vida financeira das pessoas, para proporcionar maior segurança, tranquilidade e bem-estar.

Como reconhecimento do ambiente que construímos e das oportunidades que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, a Sisprime foi selecionada como uma das LinkedIn Top Companies 2024 , um ranking que destaca as melhores empresas para quem deseja crescer profissionalmente no país. Ficamos na 7ª posição entre empresas com menos de 5.000 colaboradores , sendo a 1ª colocada no Paraná e a única cooperativa no ranking.

Recebemos também o Prêmio EXAME em Gestão de Pessoas , ficando entre as três organizações destaques do segmento, uma distinção que valoriza as práticas exemplares de recursos humanos e o compromisso com o desenvolvimento dos colaboradores.

Além disso, fomos eleitos novamente como um dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2024 (FIA/ESTADÃO), pelo terceiro ano consecutivo, reforçando nosso compromisso em manter um ambiente positivo e acolhedor.

Com essas conquistas, a Sisprime agora acumula mais de 10 premiações voltadas ao ambiente de trabalho, reafirmando nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento e o bem-estar de todos que fazem parte da nossa cooperativa!

Em nossos 27 anos de trajetória, acumulamos muitos marcos e recordes. Crescemos em abrangência, expansão das agências físicas, ativos administrados, número de cooperados e sobras distribuídas.

Atualmente, contamos com números que impressionam, como:

  • R$ 9 bilhões em recursos administrados;
  • R$ 1,3 bilhão em patrimônio líquido;
  • Mais de 52 mil cooperados;
  • 48 agências nos estados de Paraná, São Paulo, Santa Catarina, Minas Gerais e Mato Grosso do Sul.

Na Sisprime do Brasil, os cooperados não são apenas números, são histórias que se unem à nossa. São eles quem dão sentido ao nosso propósito de melhorar a vida financeira das pessoas, para proporcionar maior segurança, tranquilidade e bem-estar.

Para nós, crescer com solidez significa inovar e manter o foco naquilo que é mais importante: as pessoas. Os resultados que alcançamos só são possíveis graças ao trabalho e a dedicação de cada um dos nossos colaboradores. Temos como princípios o respeito, diálogo, oportunidades de crescimento e profissionalismo.

Confira as vagas disponíveis e venha trabalhar com a gente!


Main responsibilities

  1. Visitar cooperados no setor Agro, conforme cronograma com as agências e suas necessidades, com o objetivo de alavancar negócios para cooperativa;
  2. Identificar e buscar novos cooperados em potencial, como produtores rurais, cooperativas e revendas com o objetivo de oferecer soluções que melhor atendam as suas necessidades;
  3. Negociar taxas, condições de pagamento e prazos de entrega, estabelecendo melhores condições para os cooperados visando sempre a satisfação e a rentabilidade da operação;
  4. Elaborar propostas comerciais, montando parecer de crédito e enviando para aprovação, com o objetivo de melhores negócios para cooperativa;
  5. Analisar o mercado e concorrência, acompanhando as tendências de preços de comodities e identificando oportunidades e ameaças que possam impactar negativamente nas operações, para junto com a Diretoria montar as estratégias comerciais;
  6. Participar de feiras e eventos relacionados ao setor do Agro, colocando a cooperativa em evidência, com o objetivo de oferecer produtos e serviços competitivos com o mercado Agro;
  7. Estabelecer conexões de rede com outros profissionais do setor e identificar novas oportunidades de negócios;
  8. Treinar e capacitar a área comercial (Gerentes de Negócios) sobre as modalidades do crédito rural, prazo das operações, taxa, culturas e suas volatilidade, garantindo o uso adequado das modalidades e enquadramento das operações, de acordo com as atividades rurais de cada cooperado;
  9. Participar de reuniões com a Diretoria, para apresentar a evolução dos negócios relacionados ao Agro.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Experiência como Gerente de carteiras Agro em instituições financeiras;
  • Experiência na prospecção e gestão de carteiras;
  • Certificação CPA 10 ou CPA 20;
  • Vivência comercial;
  • Conhecimento técnico sobre análise de crédito;
  • Conhecimento geral de economia e mercado financeiro;
  • Conhecimento em Matemática Financeira;

Additional information

Benefícios:

  • Vale-alimentação e refeição;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Bolsa auxílio-educação;
  • Uniforme;
  • Vale-transporte.

title: Automation Solution Engineer – WMS
description:
Automation Solution Engineer – WMS

Job Description

You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes a certain kind of person and teams who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your professional expertise, talent, and drive to building and managing our portfolio of iconic, ground-breaking brands. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.

In this role, you will:

  • Leads and delivers the analysis, design, configuration, customization, testing, deployment and support for applications within the warehouse management business process area.
  • Working with automation vendors and cross functional IT and business teams to enable warehouses in KC.
  • Functional leader of medium to large projects for a specific business capability. Accountabilities across multiple functional and technical areas with a wide range of complexity.
  • Proactive analysis of business processes and identification of innovative ways to use technology to address near term business needs.
  • Participates with Business resources to establish requirements for the implementation of changes in the business process.
  • As part of this team, the WMS solution engineer will be responsible for integrating business, information, and technology architecture to create solutions for the relevant business capability area and in some cases, cross capability areas.
  • Focus on cost savings, business growth, as well as connecting with partners and customers.

About Us

Huggies. Kleenex. Cottonelle. Scott. Kotex. Poise. Depend. Kimberly-Clark Professional. You already know our legendary brands—and so does the rest of the world. In fact, millions of people use Kimberly-Clark products every day. We know these amazing Kimberly-Clark products wouldn’t exist without talented professionals, like you.

At Kimberly-Clark, you’ll be part of the best team committed to driving innovation, growth and impact. We’re founded on more than 150 years of market leadership, and we’re always looking for new and better ways to perform – so there’s your open door of opportunity. It’s all here for you at Kimberly-Clark.

About You

You perform at the highest level possible, and you appreciate a performance culture fueled by authentic caring. You want to be part of a company actively dedicated to sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development.
You love what you do, especially when the work you do makes a difference. At Kimberly-Clark, we’re constantly exploring new ideas on how, when, and where we can best achieve results. When you join our team, you’ll experience Flex

That Works: flexible (Hybrid) work arrangements that empower you to have purposeful time in the office and partner with your leader to make flexibility work for both you and the business.

In one of our professional roles, you’ll focus on winning with consumers and the market, while putting safety, mutual respect, and human dignity at the center. To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:

Who you are?

  • A minimum of 6 years of applied IT experience.
  • SAP functional and configuration knowledge of the SAP’s extended warehouse management (EWM).
  • Completed at least 3 end to end implementations of EWM from grounds up.
  • Integrating and defining APIs.
  • Nice to have SAP experience in Supply Chain related modules (SD, MM, LE, PP, SCM).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Verbal and written fluency in English is mandatory.
  • Possess strong leadership skills and exhibit creative thinking to be able to come up with inventive solutions to solve business challenges.
  • Comfortable consulting with resources from other disciplines and effective at working across multiple organizational boundaries.
  • Desirable Knowledge of SAP user exits, BAPI’s, and BADI’s.
  • Desirable Knowledge of ABAP concepts and ability to debug.
  • Experience working in a virtual team across distance (remote), cultures and time zones, in a matrix with multiple reporting lines.
  • Please attach your CV in English

Total Benefits

Here are just a few of the benefits you’d enjoy working in this role for Kimberly-Clark:

  • Great support for good health with medical, dental, and vision coverage options with no waiting periods or pre-existing condition restrictions.
  • Access to an on-site fitness center, occupational health nurse, and allowances for high-quality safety equipment.
  • Flexible Savings and spending accounts to maximize health care options and stretch dollars when caring for yourself or dependents.
  • Diverse income protection insurance options to protect yourself and your family in case of illness, injury, or other unexpected events.
  • Additional programs and support to continue your education, adopt a child, relocate, or even find temporary childcare.

To Be Considered
